description: Dark hide split at the shoulders and spine, lit bone standing up through it. You see one coming a long way off.
lore: On all fours, hunched, arms too long and ending in fingers, the hide split along the shoulders and spine with lit bone standing up through the splits. The keepers of the old eastern circuit called it the last mercy near [[lore/the_hole_under_the_mountain|the mouth]]: the one thing out there that cannot cross a black wood without announcing itself. [[characters/7a779de1|Wendell]] walked that circuit young, and will still trade you the saying, along with everything else he remembers of the east, for an evening's company.

[[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] will not sit through that particular evening any more. Gunnar watched one hunt. The light stood up out of its ribs at a creature that had lived in the dark long enough to give up on light, and the creature stayed exactly where it was, blind, while the long arm arrived. The light is not leaking, and it was never a mercy. It is the part that does the work.

Breaking one goes wrong in a particular way: it comes apart at the neck, the lit head leaves first, and the rest stands up on its hands a moment longer — the part everyone reaches in the telling and then skips. The light does not go down with it. [[items/banded_solar_stone|The piece it leaves]] is still burning, and not one hour of all that burning, out in all that dark, was ever lit for anybody.
gm_notes: The relationship beat is Wendell and Gunnar splitting over one saying — keep them courteous about it in play. The light is a lure, never a lantern; do not soften it back into a mercy.
